name: The Lost Ingots
label: Quest
description: The Lost Ingots is an Alliance task in the Wetlands to recover consecrated metal from a shipwreck. After finding only a single bar in a sunken chest…
intro: The Lost Ingots is an Alliance task in the Wetlands to recover consecrated metal from a shipwreck. After finding only a single bar in a sunken chest, travelers must hunt down the local Bluegill murlocs who looted the remaining shipment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Having grabbed the single lightforge ingot from the waterlogged chest, it is clear that murlocs have stolen the rest. Hunt the murloc raiders near the Flying Osprey wreckage for the lost lightforge iron.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the lightforge iron you need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you found them! Now let's get this lightforge iron hammered into something useful, eh?
